blocks.text:
Product Description               The Melissa & Doug Wooden Building Blocks Set offers endless opportunities for hands-on play and learning. With 100 solid wood blocks in four bright colors and nine classic shapes, toddlers and preschoolers can stack, balance, and build in countless combinations. Each block is sized just right for small hands, with smooth finishes and rounded edges for safe play. As kids create towers, bridges, and imaginative structures, they strengthen fine motor skills, practice problem-solving, and explore early math concepts like counting, sorting, and comparing shapes. Whether building solo or alongside friends, these blocks provide an open-ended way to encourage creativity, spatial awareness, and cooperative play. A sturdy storage box with handle makes cleanup and transport easy, so the building fun can continue wherever playtime happens. For even more imaginative role play, combine this with the Melissa and Doug wooden latches board, a Giant Giraffe & Burrow Bunny, or perhaps an Ice Cream Counter, Simmer & Stir Stovetop Play Set with Water Wow!® Color Changing Play Food & the Flip & Fry Kitchen Playset to create the ultimate pretend play world! For 35+ years, Melissa and Doug has crafted imaginative preschool toys and durable wooden toys built to nurture childhood wonder, with everything from a life-sized grocery store playset to a play kitchen playset and play food to serve plush toys & puppets, to costumes, arts & crafts, and road trip activities for kids. It’s the kind of kid-powered play that builds independence and confidence! This product is certified by the Forest Stewardship Council. FSC certification ensures that products come from responsibly managed forests that provide environmental, social, and economic benefits, and that forests are protected for future generations. Please note that FSC certification applies to new inventory only (FSC C156584)                  Amazon.com               Melissa & Doug
